title: Blotius Digital: Digitale Edition des Inventars der Wiener Hofbibliothek (1576)
author: Hugo Blotius
license_note: Transcriptions, registers and editorial texts are CC BY-SA 4.0; the digital facsimiles follow the ONB terms of use.
notes: Edition of the first surviving catalogue of the imperial court library (ÖNB Cod. 13525, 'pars posterior', M-Z, compiled 1575/76), shown beside the facsimile with registers of places, persons and works. Only part is transcribed: the page states that letters N to U are not transcribed at the moment. Counts are ours, from the downloadable TEI file (656 entries; about 10,200 words of body text). Published 2019 (TEI header 'lastChanged 2019-04-29'); no later update found, so it is listed as archived.
